target_customer: Developers and companies building AI agents that need to operate real websites
problem: Agents need reliable cloud browsers with sessions, proxies, stealth, CAPTCHA solving, logins and payments to run web tasks in production.
business_model: Usage-based API and platform for browser infrastructure

founders.name: Andrea Pinto
founders.background_notes: The YC page says the founders led ML and LLM research at MIT, Oracle and IBM Research and did years of web automation, without saying which founder worked where.

founders.name: Lucas Giordano
founders.background_notes: Same shared YC bio. The founders say they have known each other for six years.

technical_complexity.rationale: Hosting browsers at scale with stealth, residential proxies, CAPTCHA handling and authenticated profiles is standard cloud engineering with hard anti-bot parts that change constantly.

defensibility.rationale: Several managed browser providers sell similar features and Notte itself has open source components, so features are easy to copy. Differentiation rests on speed and the added agent platform.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Browserbase reportedly raised a 40M Series B, which shows well funded rivals. A later search shows many alternatives but no dated evidence of acquisition or copying of Notte.

market_need_then: AI agents that browse the web were a fast-growing use case in 2025. The company claims 20,000 developers and 1,000 organizations (self-reported).

branding.domain_note: The company uses notte.cc, not a .com. A different note-summarizing product also called Notte exists. No source describes how the domain was acquired.

identity.logo: A letter N mark per a listing

branding.community_and_virality: Launched on Product Hunt and ran a Launch Week in December 2025 with a Browser Arena (company posts, no independent press on the brand).

brand_strength.rationale: Developer launches and launch week activity exist, but no source covers the brand itself and the name origin is unknown.

outcome_analysis: Notte went through YC Summer 2025 and announced a 2.5M USD pre-seed in July 2025. It is listed as Active with a team of about five and keeps shipping, including a Launch Week in December 2025. The outcome is open, and the main pressure is better funded browser infrastructure rivals.
notes: The company website fetch was blocked by a rate-limited domain safety check, so product and customer claims come from search snippets and the YC page. The round is recorded from Vestbee (press), with Dealroom listing the same 2.5M as seed and PitchBook listing 2.92M on 2025-09-12 (snippet, unverified). Investors not named in verified sources. Neuronfeed lists an extra 500K seed in Jan 2025 and another site lists Kima Ventures, both unverified single aggregators. Competitor search returned undated 2026 comparison pages, so competitor list is empty by rule. The YC slug is nottelabs.
